verdict.rationale: FreeAgent ships its own REST API. Access and refresh tokens let scripts call it without the web UI (including via curl), and a separate sandbox API environment is available, which together support unattended automation. However, setup relies on an interactive OAuth authorization flow, and nothing documents CI usage, a CLI, or non-interactive service credentials. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs, service-account or machine credentials that avoid interactive OAuth consent, OpenAPI spec (probe 404), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: create access and refresh tokens which can be used to access the API
you can also [use it with Curl](/docs/using_curl)
The Refresh Token is used to request a new Access Token when the Access Token expires.
To use the production API (instead of the sandbox one) change the two endpoints to reference **api.freeagent.com** instead of api.sandbox.freeagent.com
